about: Scenes for the animated video of The $100 Staircase. Each scene starts at a phrase in the narration ("at"); keys ending in At name phrases that trigger a move inside the scene. Chapter cards are added at each chapter by render.mjs. Every number here is from the article and its figures.

scenes.at: Apple never asks you to jump
scenes.text: Apple never asks you to jump. It only asks you to take one more step.
